body: The 5M-step run against the new randomized-spawn training env finished (50W/0L/0D eval), promoted into packages/common/rl_policy_weights.h. Real bug caught live: rl_train.py's checkpoint loop tracked timesteps_done += chunk (requested amount) instead of model.num_timesteps (actual), causing undercounting that compounded to over 1M steps of drift across ~250 checkpoints -- the script thought it was at 4.46M/5M while the model had trained past 5.5M. Manually stopped, evaluated+exported the latest real checkpoint, fixed root cause to read the authoritative counter directly. Full suite green.
title: feat: promote spatial-generalization RL checkpoint; fix real progress-tracking bug in rl_train.py
